meta.description: Gives the paths that pass through their own fibrous relief in hyphae_to_mesh, in place of its fibres: a fibrous stipe next to a silky cap. Every path of the nodes that made them gets it, the other paths keep the fibres of hyphae_to_mesh.

plant.description: The paths, they pass through unchanged

fibres.description: Relief along these paths, 0 leaves their surface smooth. Where two values meet, the relief goes over from one to the other in a few rings of the mesh.
